description: This is a controller class for the jjwg_Maps module in a SugarCRM-based project. It handles various actions related to map visualization and geocoding, including fetching markers, geocoding addresses, exporting data, and managing map configurations. The class extends SugarController and interacts with multiple related modules such as jjwg_Markers, jjwg_Areas, and ProspectLists. It contains methods for data retrieval, geocoding, CSV export, and data marking for map display.

classes.name: jjwg_MapsController
classes.description: Controller class managing map-related operations such as geocoding, marker management, map display, and configuration within SugarCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, calls parent constructor, and loads configuration settings.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from global variables and initializes the related bean.

methods.name: action_geocoded_counts
methods.description: Calculates and displays geocoding status counts for modules.

methods.name: action_geocode_addresses
methods.description: Geocodes addresses for modules or selected records and updates address information.

methods.name: defineMapsAddressCustom
methods.description: Placeholder method for custom address logic, intended to be overridden.

methods.name: action_add_to_target_list
methods.description: Adds selected module records to a target list or prospect list.

methods.name: action_export_geocoding_addresses
methods.description: Exports addresses needing geocoding as a CSV file.

methods.name: do_list_csv_output
methods.description: Outputs CSV data for address export.

methods.name: list_row_to_csv

methods.name: action_geocoding_test

methods.name: action_config

methods.name: action_reset_geocoding
methods.description: Resets geocode information for a specific module.

methods.name: action_delete_all_address_cache
methods.description: Deletes all cached address geocoding data.

methods.name: action_quick_radius
methods.description: Displays a quick radius map UI.

methods.name: action_quick_radius_display
methods.description: Displays the quick radius map view.

methods.name: action_map_display
methods.description: Displays a map iframe with markers.

methods.name: action_donate
methods.description: Displays the donation page.

methods.name: action_map_markers
methods.description: Generates and displays map markers based on various criteria including geocoded data, target lists, or specific records, and handles related markers and areas.

methods.name: getMarkerData

methods.name: getMarkerDataCustom

methods.name: is_valid_lng

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Validates if latitude is within -90 to 90 degrees.
